metadata.client_name: McPeek Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram of Anaheim

exec_summary: Traffic held strong in May, up 8% month over month, with paid search doing the heavy lifting and organic clawing back ground on RAM towing terms. The lead-to-close gap narrowed but internet leads still close below the CDJR benchmark, so the next move is tightening speed-to-lead. Reviews ticked up on Google after the service-team push.

traffic.social_referral: Facebook 740 sessions, Instagram 310, YouTube 130. Social engagement rate trails site average by 9 pts.

insights.text: Paid is the engine: 37% of sessions and 46% of key events came from Paid Search. Healthy, but concentration risk if budget pauses.
Organic momentum: Organic Search up to 28% share on the back of RAM towing content. Lowest cost-per-event channel on the site.
Reallocate: Used Inventory CPA is 60% above the account average. Shift $500 to Service, which is converting at $58 with room to scale.
Content is landing: The RAM towing blog jumped to page 1 (#6) on a 6,600/mo term that had zero prior coverage. Add internal links to push it into the top 3.

leads.summary: May CRM shows 318 internet leads across all sources, 41 sold, for a 12.9% blended close rate. The store grades a B against the CDJR mainstream benchmark.

nada.verdict: Below the mainstream internet-lead expectation. Closing the 2-pt gap on this volume is ~7 extra units/mo.

insights.text: Speed-to-lead is the lever: Facebook leads close at 6.8%, less than half the marketplace rate. Most are first-touched after 30 min. Tighten to under 5 min.
Google trending up: +0.1 to 4.3 after the service-team review push. Yelp is the soft spot at 3.6 and drags brand-search trust.

regional.headline: California new-vehicle registrations rose modestly in Q2 2026, with trucks and SUVs outpacing the segment.
narrative: Truck demand in Southern California stayed resilient despite rate pressure, which favors McPeek's RAM-heavy mix.
Incentive spend climbing statewide gives room to lean into lease messaging without eroding front gross.

items: Built and deployed McPeek's live marketing dashboard so the GM can see leads, traffic, and PPC in one place.
Launched the $250 lease campaign on Lamar billboards plus a matching website Monthly Specials page.
Shipped 3 SEO + AI-search blog posts on RAM towing, ProMaster for business, and lease education; the towing piece already hit page 1.
Stood up the new Monthly Specials page and wired it to the campaign creative.
challenges: Close the Facebook speed-to-lead gap (under 5-min first touch).
Yelp reputation recovery plan for the service department.
